dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), developed by NACL for Japan Medical Association. Uses GnuCOBOL conventions with COPY includes (.INC files) and MCP (Message Control Program) database interface typical of JMA ORCA system.
evidence: Project code name ORCA, Copyright(C) 2002 JMA

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt) processing system - comprehensive diagnosis/treatment act bundling check (Houkatu Shinryo Koi check) for outpatient and inpatient billing
purpose.summary: This program is a subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt software that performs bundling/comprehensive medical treatment act checks (Houkatu check) for insurance claim calculation. It validates treatment codes against bundling rules, checks inpatient fee calculation periods, and handles automatic generation checks. It is called with various processing modes (1=full check, 2=auto-generation, 3=error delete, 5=inpatient fee check, 6=inpatient fee period/bundling check).

notable_features: COPY includes with .INC extension (JMA ORCA style)
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple SPA (screen parameter area) parameters
OCCURS tables for treatment code bundling rules (up to 200 entries)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary MCP middleware
verdict.notes: Comments are in Japanese EUC encoding, decoded as latin-1 resulting in garbled characters. File is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA (Orca Project) Japanese medical receipt software. Source truncated at 16000 chars out of 114034 bytes total. The MCP interface is the ORCA-specific database middleware layer replacing direct SQL.
